summary: Harrison County, TX Texas Forest Service tower No. 53, built 1936 and last used regularly in 1973; listed as gone; sources disagree on its distance from Hallsville.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date or site description found

events.note: 100-foot steel tower erected for $932.00, replacing a hickory tree a patrolman had used
Vandals broke into the tower and its lock; nothing was taken except a pencil
Survey marker set on the same hill as the tower
A young woman died after a fall from the tower, per a Corsicana Daily Sun report reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page
Last year the tower was used on a regular basis
Survey marker on the hill recorded as not found in a 2001 recovery

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on distance. The 1950 newspaper item (as reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page) puts the tower eight miles east of Hallsville; the NGS datasheet (1950 and 1957 descriptions) puts the hill that holds tower No. 53 about 4.5 miles east-northeast of Hallsville. The story states both and does not reconcile them. The 1944 and 1950 items are newspaper text seen only through the Forest Lookouts page; the newspapers themselves were not opened. The 1950 death is mentioned without the name. No removal date was found. The NGS survey-mark entries are about a benchmark, not the tower, so the story does not treat them as a record of the tower's condition. No photo found.
